paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the "Missing Step" values for two representative LLMs, labeled "0-CoT" and "CoRe", across four discrete points on the x-axis, which are labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step", ranges from approximately 0.835 to 0.850 and uses a linear scale. The "0-CoT" line is blue, marked with circles, and styled as a dashed line; it begins at a value of 0.850 when x=0 and decreases steadily to 0.838 when x=4. The "CoRe" line is orange, marked with triangles, and styled as a solid line; it starts at a value of 0.851 when x=0 and also decreases steadily, reaching 0.839 when x=4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the entire range of the x-axis.
